This aberrant signaling cascade downstream of PTPN11 results in a spectrum of developmental abnormalities and phenotypic features observed in both LEOPARD syndrome and MONDO:0013992, including short stature, congenital heart disease, intellectual disability, and other characteristic features.

**How to falsify it:** The absence of pathogenic variants in PTPN11 in individuals with MONDO:0013992, or the identification of a distinct causal gene with no link to RAS/MAPK signaling, would falsify this hypothesis.
